subject: general
question: The Ministry of Education launched the third edition of the Prime Minister’s Scheme for Mentoring Young Authors (PM-YUVA 3.0). Which of the following is NOT a theme under the PM-YUVA 3.0 scheme?

options.text: Contribution of Indian Diaspora in Nation Building

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Indian Economy and its Future**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Education launched the third edition of the Prime Minister’s Scheme for Mentoring Young Authors (PM-YUVA 3.0).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **PM-YUVA 3.0** is the third edition of the **Prime Minister’s Scheme for Mentoring Young Authors**.
 
• The scheme focuses on **training young authors** under the age of **30**.
 
• The aim is to promote **reading, writing**, and **book culture** in India.
 
• Provides **mentorship** and **publishing opportunities** for young authors.
 
• It is in line with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which promotes a **knowledge-driven ecosystem**.
 
• The scheme focuses on three key themes:
 
 
• **Contribution of Indian Diaspora in Nation Building**
 
• **Indian Knowledge System**
 
• **Makers of Modern India (1950-2025)**
 
 
 
• The **National Book Trust, India** is responsible for overseeing the implementation of PM-YUVA 3.0.
